hypothesis: Reducing the encoder update to one tenth of V2 while retaining the classifier learning rate may preserve more incumbent Dev P0 geometry and retain V2's classification gain.
exactChangeFromV2: AdamW encoder layers 10-11 learning rate 1e-6 -> 1e-7; classifier learning rate remains 1e-6
finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.

training.checkpointRule: save and evaluate the final one-epoch checkpoint only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

stoppingAndSelectionRule: one epoch; final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on all nine unchanged Dev gates, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run

v2EncoderDisplacementFromBase.measurement: L2 norm of parameter difference in saved float32 checkpoint

expectedMeasurableEffect: Encoder parameter displacement below V2 in both layers, Dev Macro-F1 near V2, and Dev P0 raw ranking, directional selection, and selected-above-plausible rate closer to incumbent than V2 without extra false positives.
